reasons.claude: Bare python/python3 is blocked. Load `efficient-python` if needed, then use `uv run script.py`, `uv run python -c ...`, `uv run --with <pkg> ...`, or `uvx <tool>`.
reasons.codex: Bare python/python3 is blocked. Load `efficient-python` if needed, then use `uv run script.py`, `uv run python -c ...`, `uv run --with <pkg> ...`, or `uvx <tool>`.
reasons.omp: Bare python/python3 is blocked. Read skill://efficient-python if needed, then use `uv run script.py`, `uv run python -c ...`, `uv run --with <pkg> ...`, or `uvx <tool>`.

reasons.claude: Shell read/search commands are blocked on this machine. Use Grep instead of grep/rg, Read with offset/limit instead of cat/head/tail/sed -n, and Glob instead of find. Mid-pipeline filters and write-mode cat remain allowed.
reasons.omp: Shell read/search commands are blocked on this machine. Use grep instead of shell grep/rg, read with a bounded selector instead of cat/head/tail/sed -n, and glob instead of find. Mid-pipeline filters and write-mode cat remain allowed.

rules.reason: Simple curl webpage fetches are blocked. Prefer the host's dedicated read/browser tools; when using ax, read ~/.agents/skills/ax/SKILL.md before the first fetch, then use ax to read or extract the page. Authenticated, API, download, diagnostic, and unsupported curl options remain allowed.
`brew upgrade` is blocked because it may remove running OMP kegs. Use `~/dotfiles/scripts/brewUpdate` instead.

reasons.claude: Shell reads of `.env`-style credential files are blocked; a matching `Read` deny rule blocks the Read tool the same way. These files hold plaintext secrets — don't load one into context unless the user explicitly asked you to inspect that exact file.
reasons.codex: Shell reads of `.env`-style credential files are blocked. These files hold plaintext secrets — don't load one into context unless the user explicitly asked you to inspect that exact file.
reasons.omp: Shell and `read`/`grep` reads of `.env`-style credential files are blocked. These files hold plaintext secrets — don't load one into context unless the user explicitly asked you to inspect that exact file.

rules.reason: PRs are created as drafts on this machine. Re-run `gh pr create` with `--draft`; mark it ready only when the user asks.

reasons.claude: Sleeps of 10s or more are blocked: don't poll. Wait on the event itself in one background command (`run_in_background`): `gh pr checks <PR> --watch --fail-fast`, `gh run watch <id> --exit-status`, or a readiness loop with a short sleep.
reasons.codex: Sleeps of 10s or more are blocked: don't poll. Wait on the event itself in one command: `gh pr checks <PR> --watch --fail-fast`, `gh run watch <id> --exit-status`, or a readiness loop with a short sleep.
reasons.omp: Sleeps of 10s or more are blocked: don't poll. Run one async bash that waits on the event itself (`gh pr checks <PR> --watch --fail-fast`, `gh run watch <id> --exit-status`); its result is delivered automatically. For servers use a named bash service with `ready`.

rules.reason: Ad hoc global installs are blocked: every tool has an owning file. Ask the user first, then declare it there and run the owner — macOS tools: `~/.Brewfile` + `brew bundle --file ~/.Brewfile`; cross-platform toolchains: `~/dotfiles/devbox/devbox.json` + `~/dotfiles/scripts/devbox`; uv tools: `~/dotfiles/scripts/python`; npm CLIs: `~/dotfiles/scripts/apps`. Project-local installs (`npm install`, `uv add`, `go get`) stay allowed.

Sweeping stages (`git add -A/./-u`, `git commit -a`) are blocked: they pick up the user's unrelated edits. Stage the paths you changed explicitly: `git add path/a path/b`, then check `git diff --cached --stat`.

Raw `git worktree add` is blocked inside Herdr: use Herdr-managed worktrees. New branch: `herdr worktree create --cwd <repo> --branch <name> --base <ref> --no-focus`; existing branch: `herdr worktree open --cwd <repo> --branch <name> --no-focus`. Read skill://herdr first.

reasons.claude: In-place shell edits (`sed -i`, `perl -pi`) are blocked. Use Edit/Write; for the same rewrite across many files use ast-grep (`structural-edit` skill).
reasons.omp: In-place shell edits (`sed -i`, `perl -pi`) are blocked. Use `edit`/`write`; for the same rewrite across many files use `xd://ast_edit`.

rules.reason: `hunk diff --watch` is the human's review surface; agents never launch it. Ask the user to open it, then use the `hunk-review` skill against the live session.
